messages:
alex wang: heads up — deploybot just blocked the canary for release 2025.04.02 (artifact: release-2025.04.02+build.789). reason: supply-audit mismatch + unknown license in test-only layer.

deploy-bot: automatic block: provenance_hash_mismatch OR license_flagged(test-only). See /deploybot report 789.
maria gonzalez: copying the audit output here, license is `GPL-2.0-or-later` flagged in `tools/test-helper` image layer — looks like a transitive test dep.
raj singh: is this pulled into production image or only in CI/test layer?
maria gonzalez: only CI/test layer per the SBOM; runtime layers are clean. attaching snippet: ```
artifact: release-2025.04.02+build.789
layer: tools/test-helper
license: GPL-2.0-or-later
provenance: unknown (missing build metadata)
```
alex wang: key questions: 1) do we need to block production rollout because of a test-only license? 2) can we record an exception and roll forward? 3) what audit trail/legal approval is required?
legal-team: quick take — GPL-2.0-or-later in a test-only tool doesn't typically constrain our runtime distribution, but we need a written exception noting it's CI-only and not shipped to customers. Requires a review and sign-off from security+legal.
sre-oncall: ops note: if we approve an exception, add a pinned artifact with explicit provenance (signed) so deploybot can un-block. Otherwise we should hold to next change window (4/2 1600 PT).
raj singh: practical path: create a short-lived exception ticket (SEC-EX-420) with links to SBOM and CI logs, legal sign-off, and then set deploybot override for the canary only. I can generate the ticket and provenance patch.
maria gonzalez: agreed. i'll remove the test-only layer from the published SBOM for runtime images (we already separate SBOM profiles), and add note in release notes.
alex wang: action items: 1) raj create SEC-EX-420 and ping @legal-team and @sre-oncall (deadline 2 hours). 2) maria update SBOM profiles + release notes. 3) raj attach signed provenance and call `/deploybot override SEC-EX-420 --scope canary --expires 2025-04-03T00:00Z` once legal signs. If legal denies, we rollback the canary and push to next change window.
raj singh: creating SEC-EX-420 now and assigning to @legal-team. will include logs + commands to reproduce.
legal-team: got it — will review within 90 min. please include the CI artifact sha and confirmation that runtime image does not include the layer.
maria gonzalez: added SBOM diff and release-note line: "test helper dep flagged GPL-2.0-or-later; CI-only; exception requested; no customer distribution impact."
deploy-bot: note: override requires ticket reference and `signed_provenance` file. any manual `/deploybot override` without these will be rejected.
raj singh: uploaded signed provenance blob to SEC-EX-420 and tagged legal sign-off comment. calling `/deploybot override SEC-EX-420 --scope canary --expires 2025-04-03T00:00Z` now.
deploy-bot: override accepted for canary. will allow canary rollout only. audit: SEC-EX-420, actor=raj singh, expiry=2025-04-03T00:00Z.
alex wang: thanks team. leaving this thread open until the canary finishes. if legal changes decision, we will abort and rollback. :thumbsup:
legal-team: signed off — added formal note to the ticket. no further action from legal unless state changes.
sre-oncall: monitoring canary. i'll post metrics and latency check at +30m and +2h.
raj singh: canary passed +45m, metrics green. closing SEC-EX-420 as exception applied and evidence attached.
maria gonzalez: releasing patch to docs with SBOM clarification.
alex wang: closing thread in 1h after final log archive uploaded. thanks all.
